WITH site_rates AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN s.riskeval IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_missing_status,
    s.riskeval,
    AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_rate
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  GROUP BY is_missing_status, s.riskeval
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS benchmark_rate
  FROM site_rates
),
above AS (
  SELECT sr.avg_rate, b.benchmark_rate
  FROM site_rates AS sr
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE b.benchmark_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND sr.avg_rate > b.benchmark_rate
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rate) AS average_rate,
  AVG(avg_rate - benchmark_rate) AS average_margin_above_benchmark
FROM above;

assumptions.assumption: A scan contributes its GB-per-minute rate only when its site matches a row in sites; NULL or zero scan durations yield NULL rates and are excluded from the averages. Sites with a matching scan but no non-NULL rate still form a status group, whose rate is NULL and does not affect the benchmark.
